item.title: Watch FEMME FATALE's New Video for 'Living Like There's No Tomorrow'
item.description: Femme Fatale, the rock band led by Lorraine Lewis, has returned with a new song called “Living Like There’s No Tomorrow” (watch it below). The track is now available through Cleopatra Records, and its official music video, directed by Vicente Cordero, is out now.
